meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 它会调查 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的 bug,拉取最新源码和运行证据定位根因,判断归属仓库,然后用模板创建带复现步骤、根因分析和修复建议的英文 GitHub issue;仅在 openai/codex 且条件满足时创建 PR。
howto.when: 当用户要求上报、登记或处理 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发,尤其是需要源码根因、复现步骤、修复建议和 GitHub 归属时。

say.text: 帮我把 LazyCodex 安装失败的 bug 报成 issue,带上复现步骤。
say.note: 它会先找根因,再决定发到哪个仓库。

say.text: 查一下这个 Codex 插件 MCP 报错的根源,该提 issue 还是 PR?
say.note: 它按源码证据路由到正确的仓库。

say.text: 给 openai/codex 创建修复 sandbox 审批问题的 PR。
say.note: 满足条件时才建 PR,否则转成 issue。

howto.what_en: Investigates LazyCodex/Codex CLI bugs, fetches latest sources and runtime evidence to identify root cause, picks the owning GitHub repo, then creates an English bug issue with reproduction, root cause, and fix guidance. PRs only for openai/codex when conditions allow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, or the upstream Codex CLI, especially when root cause, reproduction, fix guidance, and GitHub routing are needed.

say_en.text: File an issue for the LazyCodex installation failure with reproduction steps.
say_en.note: It finds the root cause first, then routes to the right repo.

say_en.text: Investigate this Codex plugin MCP error and tell me whether to file an issue or a PR.
say_en.note: It routes based on source evidence.

say_en.text: Create a PR for openai/codex to fix the sandbox approval issue.
say_en.note: Only creates a PR when conditions are met; otherwise becomes an issue.
